I am an old woman with no schooling, and my piece of land is very small, only 0.08 hectares. I cannot afford chemical fertilizer or pesticides from the shop, and this plot is too tiny to waste money on hired workers. I will use manure from my animals to make the soil fertile, and I will plant the seeds I have saved from last season because they are free and I know they grow well here. My children and grandchildren will help me weed and harvest when the rains come, so we do not need to pay anyone.
